Line 1: Integer flags
Line 2: Integer mask
output_format: Four lines: three integers followed by true or false.
hint_1: | sets the masked bits, and ^ toggles them.
hint_2: ~mask has 1s everywhere except the masked bits, so flags & ~mask clears those bits.
hint_3: (flags & mask) != 0 needs its parentheses because != has higher precedence than &.
